claims.claim_text_normalized: Feature Pyramid Networks show significant improvement as a generic feature extractor in several applications.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This architecture, called a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN), shows significant improvement as a generic feature extractor in several applications.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using FPN in a basic Faster R-CNN system achieves state-of-the-art single-model results on the COCO detection benchmark.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Using FPN in a basic Faster R-CNN system, our method achieves state-of-the-art single-model results on the COCO detection benchmark without bells and whistles

claims.claim_text_normalized: Featurizing each level of an image pyramid increases inference time considerably.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Inference time increases considerably (e.g., by four times [11]), making this approach impractical for real applications.

claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD misses the opportunity to reuse the higher-resolution maps of the feature hierarchy.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Thus it misses the opportunity to reuse the higher-resolution maps of the feature hierarchy.

claims.claim_text_normalized: For bounding box proposals, FPN significantly increases the Average Recall by 8.0 points.
claims.evidence_quote_short: In ablation experiments, we find that for bounding box proposals, FPN significantly increases the Average Recall (AR) by 8.0 points

claims.claim_text_normalized: Our method can run at 6 FPS on a GPU and thus is a practical solution to multi-scale object detection.
claims.evidence_quote_short: In addition, our method can run at 6 FPS on a GPU and thus is a practical and accurate solution to multi-scale object detection.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The pyramid structure can be trained end-to-end with all scales and is used consistently at train/test time.
claims.evidence_quote_short: In addition, our pyramid structure can be trained end-to-end with all scales and is used consistently at train/test time

claims.claim_text_normalized: Our method outperforms the accuracy of previous mask proposal approaches by over 8.3 points AR.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We outperform the accuracy of these approaches by over 8.3 points AR.
